test_cases.expected_behavior: Emits message_start, tokens, usage, message_complete in order; commits user and assistant messages to database
test_cases.actual_behavior: Ordered SSE sequence matches exact contract; user and assistant message persisted
test_cases.execution_method: Deterministic offline mock streaming via AssistantRuntime

test_cases.expected_behavior: Catches httpx.ConnectTimeout, normalizes to LLMTimeoutError, redacts internal details
test_cases.actual_behavior: LLMTimeoutError raised with message 'Connection to LLM provider timed out after 45.0s'

test_cases.scenario: Upstream provider connection refused / network error
test_cases.expected_behavior: Catches httpx.ConnectError, normalizes to LLMConnectionError, redacts internal socket info
test_cases.actual_behavior: LLMConnectionError raised with message 'Failed to connect to LLM provider: Connection refused'

test_cases.scenario: Upstream provider returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden
test_cases.expected_behavior: Normalizes to LLMAuthenticationError, prevents secret leakage
test_cases.actual_behavior: LLMAuthenticationError raised with message 'LLM provider authentication failed (401)'
test_cases.execution_method: httpx mock transport returning 401 and 403 status codes

test_cases.scenario: Upstream provider returns HTTP 429 Rate Limit Exceeded
test_cases.expected_behavior: Normalizes to LLMRateLimitError with retry hint
test_cases.actual_behavior: LLMRateLimitError raised with message 'LLM provider rate limit exceeded (429)'
test_cases.execution_method: httpx mock transport returning 429 status code

test_cases.scenario: Upstream provider returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
test_cases.expected_behavior: Normalizes to LLMProviderError without leaking upstream stack trace
test_cases.actual_behavior: LLMProviderError raised with message 'LLM provider server error (500)'
test_cases.execution_method: httpx mock transport returning 500 status code

test_cases.scenario: Provider failure emits sanitized error frame through SSE stream
test_cases.expected_behavior: Emits message_error frame, redacts any API key or secret token, suppresses message_complete
test_cases.actual_behavior: Single message_error emitted with redacted error message; no message_complete emitted; no DB commit
test_cases.execution_method: Failing mock provider streaming through AssistantRuntime

test_cases.expected_behavior: Rejects empty generation; emits message_error; prevents blank message persistence
test_cases.actual_behavior: message_error emitted with 'LLM generation yielded an empty response'; 0 assistant messages persisted
test_cases.execution_method: Empty iterator mock provider through AssistantRuntime

test_cases.scenario: Client disconnect / cancellation during token streaming
test_cases.expected_behavior: Generation stops early; upstream connection closed; no message_complete emitted; database session rolled back
test_cases.actual_behavior: Async generator broke after 2 tokens; message_complete not emitted; no partial assistant message persisted
test_cases.execution_method: Early generator break simulation in async consumer loop

test_cases.scenario: Atomic persistence of user message, assistant message, and citations
test_cases.expected_behavior: All entities committed together only upon verified generation completion
test_cases.actual_behavior: User message and assistant message both stored; citation tied directly to verified chunk and document
test_cases.execution_method: Full assistant runtime flow with vector retrieval candidate

test_cases.actual_behavior: Conversation message count remains exactly 0 following failed streaming attempt
